_readme: Illustrations manifest — Jon fills this; the room renders a grid of whatever is here, in order.
Each item: { "src": string, "alt": string, "title": optional string, "year": optional number }.
Drop image files in /public/studio/illustrations/ and reference them as
/studio/illustrations/<name>.webp — WebP or PNG, ~1200px on the long edge keeps the room light.
Example row: { "src": "/studio/illustrations/sketch-01.webp", "alt": "Sharpie sketch of a synth", "title": "Synth study", "year": 2026 }
An empty list shows a plain empty state.
